pages.title: Bouncing Animal Cow White & Black with Pump
pages.description: Jamara Bouncing Animal Cow. Promotes balance and motor skills, easy to clean, and includes an air pump. Clarkes of Cavan
pages.ld_description:
Introduce your child to the delightful world of bouncing fun with the Jamara Bouncing Animal Cow. This charming white and black cow is designed to provide hours of entertainment while promoting essential physical development skills in children as young as 12 months.

Key Features:


	Promotes Balance and Motor Skills: The bouncing motion helps improve your child's balance and motor skills, making it a fun way to encourage physical development.
	Secure and Comfortable: The animal's ears serve as handles, providing a secure and comfortable grip for your child during play.
	Easy to Inflate: The included air pump makes inflation simple and quick, ensuring the bouncy cow is ready for use in no time.
	Durable and Easy to Clean: Made from robust and hard-wearing materials, this bouncy animal is built to last and is easy to clean, ensuring long-term use.
	BPA Free: Safe for your child, the material used is free from harmful BPA, providing peace of mind for parents.


Dimensions and Weight:


	Seat Height: 24.5 - 27 cm
	Maximum Weight: 50 kg
	Shipping Weight: 1.73 kg
	Item Weight: 1.45 kg
	Dimensions (L x W x H): 58.00 × 31.00 × 55.00 cm


Perfect For:


	Developing balance and motor skills in children
	Providing a fun and safe bouncing experience
	Both indoor and outdoor play
	Children aged 12 months and above
